doc.title: Lorraine Feather interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 22, 2023

title: Bela Fleck and 'Peculiar Universe'
summary: She wrote words to a Fleck tune; he played on it remotely for the Ages album.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: I don’t know Bela Fleck. I heard something of his. I was just looking around on Amazon for music when I was writing this album called “Ages” and I heard a tune of his called “Circus of Regrets” I believe it was. I got in touch with him. Somehow or other I wrote words to it and called it “Peculiar Universe.” And I made a little recording of it in my home studio, Tony’s and my home studio, and sent it to him and whoever it was who manages him said, “Well he usually doesn’t agree to things like that.” But he said yes. And I asked him if he’d play on it, which he did while he was on the road. And it was on my “Ages” album. But I’ve never — I’ve seen him perform, I love him, but I’ve never actually met him.
That’s so interesting this day and age, I guess that’s like exchange of sound files.
